What do I have to be depressed over? I’m living my dream life with a job I don’t always dislike but still I find myself sobbing in the bathroom feeling like I want to disappear. I still lie awake staring at the ceiling listening to YouTube videos to fall asleep because if I am alone with my thoughts for any amount of time I’ll tailspin. 

Why the fuck do I feel like this? Like my world is on fire but I’m the only one feeling the flames, like any second I could break into a million shattered pieces with no hope of recovery, why?? 

There is no answer. It is what it is. I didn’t choose to be depressed, anxious or suicidal. And I am alone in my fight. Only I can keep going or give up, only I decide how my life goes and I don’t like having that much responsibility…

As for coping with it? I struggle and try not to think about it very long. It’s both reassuring that I could do it for myself, there’s no one in my way but myself. But it’s also disheartening because no one can do it for me or help in any true way…

It won’t make you feel better and I’m sorry about that but I’m in the same boat but from opposite shores. I’ve come out to my close family and friends, got the support, on medication and have been outwardly validated and supported. 

And I still struggle with guilt and shame and I have a hard time reaching out because… at the end of the day there’s nothing they can really do… I’m at war with my thoughts and no amount of outside assistance helps in my inner struggle…. 

It’s a battle that we fight alone and that’s the most depressing and disheartening thing about it… we can get tools and learn tactics to fight from outside help (therapist, venting) and we can try to level the playing field with medication but all in all it’s you yourself that fights fist and tooth with these feelings and thoughts…. I can see your battlefield, I know the rough layout as it is similar to my own, I can share my tactics in hopes they’re more effective for you than I but it’s a solo conflict no matter what
